mapper.select: select * from mvcboard2 order by bno desc
mapper.insert: insert into mvcboard2 (bname, bpass,btitle, bcontent, bip, bfile) values (#{bname}, #{bpass}, #{btitle}, #{bcontent}, #{bip}, #{bfile})
mapper.update: update mvcboard2 set btitle=#{btitle}, bcontent=#{bcontent}, bfile=#{bfile} where bno = #{bno}
update mvcboard2 set bhit= bhit+1 where bno = #{bno}
mapper.select: select * from mvcboard2 where bno = #{bno} and bpass= #{bpass}
